jobs.occupation: Senior Quality Engineer / all genders / Part-Fulltime (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Everything we do in Electronics is to help us deliver on our purpose of being the company behind the companies, advancing digital living. We are dedicated to being the trusted supplier of high-tech materials, services and specialty chemicals for the electronics, automotive and cosmetics industries. We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. Together, we push the boundaries of science to make more possible for our customers.Your roleHelp bring next-generation formulation materials to scale by building quality and reliability into products and processes from development through high-volume manufacturing. You’ll work hands-on with R&D, process scale-up, QC, supply chain, facilities, and manufacturing teams to identify customer and process risks early in new product introduction. You’ll guide risk mitigation, change control, and continuous improvement so products and processes are ready for reliable commercialization and sustained performance. You’ll ensure disciplined analytics and effective process controls are in place to monitor product and process health. As a voice of the customer, you’ll help cross-functional teams resolve issues quickly, assess deviations rigorously, and minimize customer impact. You’ll lead structured problem solving and effective corrective and preventive actions, while helping teams identify abnormal events and sources of variation. You’ll strengthen a proactive quality culture, contribute to site audits, and champion improvements that keep pace with semiconductor customers’ needs. You’ll collaborate across sites and time zones, with travel to global manufacturing locations and, when needed, customer sites.Who you are- You have a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another technical discipline.- You bring at least eight years of experience in chemical manufacturing, process or control engineering, analytical chemistry, and/or semiconductor fabrication.- You communicate excellently in written and spoken English.- You have a safety- and quality-focused approach to process controls, risk assessment, and reducing variation; semiconductor industry experience, particularly in fab process engineering, is an advantage.- You have working knowledge of SPC and statistical methods such as t-tests, ANOVA, and univariate or multivariate modeling.- You have experience with quality and problem-solving methods such as 5 Whys, segmentation, model-based problem solving, FMEAs, CAPA, change management, continuous improvement, and document control.- You are comfortable with data and process-improvement tools such as JMP, Palantir Foundry, Tableau, Python, JSL, or SAP; experience with data automation, digitization, and ISO 9001 quality systems is valued.- You build strong cross-functional relationships, motivate others, and stay organized, attentive to detail, and resilient through ambiguity; auditor or Six Sigma certification and additional languages are a plus.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Senior Director (m/f/d) - Digital & AI R&D Transformation (Leiter/in - Forschung und Entwicklung)
jobs.description: About usThe Senior Director, Digital & AI R&D Transformation shapes Fresenius Kabi's future Digital & AI agenda for Research & Development.With senior R&D, Medical, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality and Business Unit leaders, the role defines the digital vision for discovering, developing and sustaining products beyond 2030, enabling increasingly AI-first, data-driven, connected and digitally enabled R&D.As R&D leadership's strategic Digital & AI partner, the role owns the R&D Digital & AI Trend Radar, continuously assessing emerging technologies, scientific advances, industry developments and disruptive innovations over a 3-5 year horizon. It translates trends into actionable recommendations on organizational implications and opportunities to improve speed, quality, evidence generation and portfolio value.The role provides end-to-end Digital & AI portfolio transparency across R&D, serving as the primary reference for ongoing, planned and emerging initiatives. It identifies, prioritizes and sequences opportunities across discovery, formulation and product development, clinical development, regulatory affairs, medical evidence and R&D knowledge management, guiding investment and recommendations to continue, scale, evolve or stop initiatives.Through an agile team of AI & Digital Innovation Acceleration Managers and Business Unit partners, the role translates R&D challenges and ambitions into Digital & AI use cases, guiding strategic advisory, opportunity identification and proof-of-value pilots, with recommendations and decision support for investment and scaling.With the Digital & AI Capability and Workforce Strategy & Engagement teams, the role strengthens digital capabilities, adoption and workforce transformation for AI-enabled R&D. As an external ambassador, it represents Fresenius Kabi's Digital & AI perspective in relevant life-science forums, innovation networks and strategic partnerships, aligned with Group and segment stakeholders.Your responsibilitiesShape the Future of R&D- Define the Digital & AI vision for R&D across the end-to-end product development lifecycle.- Continuously assess external market trends, emerging technologies, scientific advances and leading practices in life sciences R&D.- Identify future capability requirements needed to improve development speed, scientific quality, regulatory readiness and portfolio competitiveness over the next 3-5 years.- Develop strategic roadmaps that balance long-term ambition with practical execution in a regulated and heterogeneous R&D environment.Trend Monitoring & Innovation Scouting- Establish a systematic process to identify and assess emerging technologies through an R&D Trend Radar, and regularly communicate findings across R&D and Digital governance bodies.- Build partnerships with technology providers, start-ups, academic institutions, research networks and relevant industry consortia.- Assess each trend against maturity, scientific and business relevance, GxP and regulatory implications, responsible AI requirements, cross-Business-Unit scalability and value, with a clear recommendation to act, pilot, monitor or discontinue.Digital Portfolio Ownership & Synergy Realization- Own the portfolio view of Digital & AI initiatives across R&D and maintain transparency of the digital maturity landscape across functions and Business Units as the foundation for scaling decisions.- Identify duplication, capability gaps and synergies; recommend consolidation, reuse or scaling opportunities; and prioritize investments based on strategic importance, scientific impact, business value and feasibility.- Connect related initiatives across R&D, Quality, TechOps, Commercial, Data & Analytics and Kabi IT to strengthen reuse and end-to-end value.Big Bets, Use Cases & Proof of Value- Identify high-value AI and digital opportunities across scientific knowledge discovery, formulation and process development, clinical development, evidence generation, regulatory authoring and intelligence, and R&D operations.- Shape high-impact use cases together with Business Unit Digital Partners and R&D leaders, including value cases, success criteria, data requirements, responsible AI considerations and committed business sponsors.- Functionally lead an agile delivery team during the Proof of Value phase, own the go/no-go decision gate following completion and ensure a scalable transition into R&D functions and Kabi IT.- Steer value realization throughout broader deployment and support lighthouse use cases that make the future-state R&D vision tangible.Lead Business Transformation- Serve as a trusted advisor and single point of entry into Digital & AI for senior R&D stakeholders across Business Units and global functions; facilitate cross-Business-Unit strategic dialogue and support executive decision preparation.- Ensure global solutions are designed for reuse, interoperability and scalability across product areas, regions and Business Units.- Align R&D, Digital & AI and technology stakeholders around common objectives. Act as the key interface to Kabi IT, Fresenius Digital Technology, Data & Analytics, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Medical Affairs; lead through expertise and relationships while proactively identifying strategic risks and escalating significant deviations.- Champion fit-for-purpose data foundations, knowledge management and responsible AI practices that enable trusted reuse of scientific and development data.- Leverage Enablement and Transformation resources within the team to strengthen digital capabilities, drive adoption and support the workforce transformation required for AI-enabled R&D.Your qualifications- At least 10 years' relevant experience in R&D, product or clinical development, regulatory or medical affairs, or a closely related field, including significant experience in global pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical technology, biotechnology or similarly regulated R&D environments.- University degree in science, medicine, engineering, technology or business;
